title: What You Need To Know About Shipping Insurance
body_markdown:
Why Insurance? For a lot of people engaged in trade, either as a small or medium sized enterprise, shipping takes a considerable amount of overall business costs, so it is understandable that the extra cost of paying shipping insurance can seem unnecessary.


**What is shipping insurance?**


[Shipping insurance](https://www.instagram.com/p/CGRygbelnxz/) is a policy that may refund shippers whose packages are damaged, lost or damaged while in transit. It is no different from the coverage you might take out for your health, your car or your business.


**Why you should invest in shipping insurance**


While most shipments get to their destinations intact, there are still unforeseen risks associated with shipping goods. For example, you are a seller shipping goods both locally and internationally to your customers. One time, your package gets lost in transit, you cannot order a new package and your customer wants a refund. Luckily for you, you have invested in insurance and you are protected.


At Sendbox, we offer two types of Insurance: Standard Insurance and Extended Insurance.


**Standard insurance**


This insurance is absolutely free. However, you are only entitled to a compensation fee of N10,000 should there be an issue of missing or damaged packages, regardless of the worth of the package.


**Extended insurance**


We understand that some shipments need more than the standard insurance coverage. With this, we charge N1,500 for packages valued below N100,000 and 2% of packages valued above N100,000. This means that you are entitled to a compensation fee up to N200,000 coverage if there is an issue of missing or damaged packages.


With Sendbox, you can be rest assured that all your shipments are protected regardless of your insurance type.
